question: What must be done one hundred thousand times in the forehead-syllable mass for the god-worshipped?
premises: One hundred thousand repetitions are prescribed.
They are situated in the forehead-syllable mass.
The rite is addressed to the god-worshipped.
inference: The practitioner must complete one hundred thousand repetitions in the forehead-syllable mass for the worshipped god.
uncertainties: The exact ritual referent of forehead-syllable mass is not specified.
